description.value: Lucky Fortune Seafood Restaurant (天喜海鲜酒家) is a long-standing Cantonese-style seafood restaurant on Granville Street in South Vancouver, serving a broad range of regional Chinese cuisines including Cantonese, Sichuan, and Shanghainese dishes. It accommodates tourist groups and banquet-style dining, which could suit larger cycling parties. Dine-in, pickup, delivery, and catering are all available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 24m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 52m; stands (3 spaces) at 63m; rack (2 spaces) at 63m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant name, address (8012 Granville St, Vancouver, BC V6P 4Z5), and phone (604) 261-6328, and explicitly lists Pickup and Delivery as service modes, supporting a Takeout value of true. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all remain null. The site is very sparse — essentially a single metadata page with SEO keywords and no detailed amenity information.
concerns: Phone number (604) 261-6328 appears only on website; OSM has no phone field — unable to cross-confirm against OSM.
Website is a minimal single-page metadata/SEO dump (1287 bytes) with no substantive amenity or facility information, limiting evidence quality.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate operating restaurant that could serve touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. The website is extremely sparse and provides no amenity detail beyond service modes.
